```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple:
    # Try to locate a closing price column in a robust way
    close_col = None
    for candidate in ["Close", "close", "Closing Price", "closing_price", "closing"]:
        if candidate in df.columns:
            close_col = candidate
            break

    if close_col is None:
        # Fall back to the first numeric column if no obvious closing-price column exists
        numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
        if len(numeric_cols) == 0:
            raise ValueError("No numeric column found to visualize closing prices.")
        close_col = numeric_cols[0]

    prices = df[close_col].dropna()

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

    # Box plot
    sns.boxplot(y=prices, ax=axes[0], color="skyblue")
    axes[0].set_title("Box Plot of Closing Prices")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("Closing Price")

    # Histogram
    sns.histplot(prices, bins=30, kde=True, ax=axes[1], color="steelblue")
    axes[1].set_title("Histogram of Closing Prices")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Closing Price")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Frequency")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return axes[0], axes[1]
```
